checkpoint_selection: Fixed snapshots after episodes 512 and 1024; both chosen before outcomes, neither selected by fit or evaluation quality.
cost_law: imports+construction + 262144 training team steps + 2048 ordered full-rollout replay/backward/Adam calls + 2 fixed snapshot serializations + 6 checkpoint loads + 98304 evaluation team steps + six C/F/dwell stage checks + paired endpoint/change publication and process exit

primary.metric: J=S/256; S is the complete native team reward sum
primary.uncertainty: Endpoint and direct within-world difference-of-differences sample SD/sqrt(64), conditional on one correlated fresh programme; no training-population uncertainty or equivalence claim.

timing_boundary: Runner timing starts before imports and is sampled immediately before summary serialization; GNU time encloses admission-adjacent execution through actual exit.
